title: viola tricolor var. parvula
intro: Viola tricolor var. parvula, commonly known as Wild Pansy or Heart's Ease, is a small, herbaceous perennial plant belonging to the violet family (Violaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor var. parvula are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, such as vitexin and orientin, as well as triterpenes and glycosides, which may exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic effects. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Wild Pansy may also contribute to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief and sleep support.
